title: Publish badge from the main report runs' plan links; exam INDEX ignores line-level INDEX.md (REQ-0102)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 run-list publish badge from main report links
AC2 exam INDEX no unregistered row for generated INDEX.md/run.json, unknown file still flagged

design.summary: run-list badge published iff a complete main report run links the plan run through plan_runs (existing linked() handles aliases), else dev; exam-level INDEX skips generated INDEX.md (first line '# Reports index: ') and run.json; Lines table unchanged

implementation.summary: run-list publish badge = plan runs linked by a complete main report run's plan_runs (existing linked() with aliases), else dev; exam-level INDEX skips generated INDEX.md and run.json (unregistered rows dgnl2026 18->3, dhqg2024 19->4 on scratch copies); real run-list matches the design; --affected 1093 OK

unit_test.result: gate: ran 1894, new=[], known=4, gate_ok true, 367.5 s, worktree removed; test_publish_badge 11 OK (8 fail on the previous code); --fast 1874 tests 54.4 s only the 4 known

security.result: display-only change; no write to plans/ or reports/ other than regenerated INDEX.md; no model call, no shell

verification.command: python3 -I scripts/exam.py run-list dgnl2026/dhqg2024; report-index on both exam folders; plans/ sha256 compare; gate --full
verification.result: 22 run-list rows equal the verifier's recomputation from main report run.json plan_runs (8 published, 14 dev, 0 diffs); exam-level unregistered rows 18->3 and 19->4 (the remaining 7 are superseded files, cosmetic follow-up D1); plans/ 1599 files sha256 identical; only cli.py and report_kinds.py changed; gate ran 1894, new=[], known=4; verifier AC1-AC3 PASS

quality.reason: every run-list badge recomputed from the real report run.json plan_runs by the verifier; plans/ hashes compared
